instruction: Can you increase the color depth from 8-bit to 16-bit per channel and add more color information without any interpolation or estimation?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because increasing bit depth from 8-bit to 16-bit per channel requires adding color information that doesn't exist in the original 8-bit JPEG. Without interpolation or estimation, there's no way to generate the additional bit depth data - you cannot create information from nothing.
